cues.en: Oh, excuse me. I'm sorry. My fault.
cues.zh: 哦，抱歉，不好意思。是我的错。

cues.en: I'm sorry I'm late. I had to attend the reading of a will.
cues.zh: 抱歉，我迟到了。我得去听遗嘱宣读。

cues.en: I had to stay to the very end when I found out I received nothing.
cues.zh: 发现自己什么也没得到，我只好待到最后。

cues.en: would you hold my wallet while I take the test, please? There's a thousand dollars in there.
cues.zh: 我考试的时候，能帮我拿一下钱包吗？里面有一千美元。

cues.en: You know what I mean? Are you saying I can take this money if I help you pass the test?
cues.zh: 你懂我的意思吧？你是说，只要我帮你通过考试，这笔钱就归我？

cues.en: So where do I Sit down.
everybody. Please stand back. I am a trained cardiovascular
cues.zh: 大家请后退。我是受过培训的心血管

cues.en: I want all of you to stand back. This man needs air. In fact, all of you should leave the room.
cues.zh: 大家都退后，这位男士需要空气。事实上，你们所有人都该离开房间。
